about_the_game:
Natalie & Soldiers is an adult adventure game in which you play as a female protagonist Natalie.

Natalie is a student who returns to her grandmother’s village somewhere in Eastern Europe for the summer, hoping to reconnect with some of the local guys she had fun with during previous visits. However, upon her arrival, she discovers something shocking—the village has no men. After speaking with her grandmother, she learns that all the men were recently mobilized and locked away in cages, preparing to be sent off to war.

Unable to accept this, Natalie decides to take matters into her own hands and free the men.

Your objective in the game is to navigate through the village, avoid patrolling soldiers, and release the imprisoned men. But there’s a catch: after each rescue, you'll need to satisfy their desires.

Features

  • 10 challenging levels – Each stage becomes progressively harder. For example, in later levels you’ll encounter block posts that can only be destroyed using a special collectible: dynamite.

  • Dynamic cutscenes – Free captives to unlock story moments. The game includes over 10 unique cutscenes featuring adult content.

  • Stealth and danger – Beware of patrolling guards. If they catch you, you’ll need to rely on your limited supply of… protection. Use it wisely!

  • Fully voiced experience – Enjoy quality voice-over that brings the characters and atmosphere to life.

  • Polished animations – Smooth platforming sequences and detailed cutscenes keep the action exciting and immersive.

  • 3+ hours of gameplay – Unlock all 10 levels and experience the full adventure.

  • Gallery mode – Revisit unlocked scenes at any time.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains explicit sexual animations between adult characters (18+), including nudity and simulated sexual acts.

Some sexual scenarios occur in a fictional fantasy context and may involve power imbalance or situations where consent is implied, ambiguous, or potentially dubious, such as encounters following a character being captured. These scenes do not depict graphic violence or physical harm, but may be interpreted as implied or non-explicitly stated consent.

The game does not include graphic or extreme violence, sexual content involving minors, incest, bestiality, self-harm, suicide, drug use, or alcohol abuse.

All characters are adults, and the content is intended for a mature audience comfortable with explicit sexual themes, including sensitive or morally complex situations.
